notes:
JAPANESE AQUACULTURE:
Japan is a major aquaculture producer, especially for:
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧/⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧ - salmon
- ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ - sea bream
- ⟦{牡蠣|かき}→牡蠣：10786_kaki⟧ - oysters
- ⟦{海苔|のり}→海苔：10391_nori⟧ - seaweed/nori
- うなぎ - eel
- {鮪|まぐろ} - tuna (recent developments)
- ホタテ - scallops

PEARL CULTIVATION:
{養殖|ようしょく}⟦{真珠|しんじゅ}→真珠：19873_shinju⟧ (cultured pearls) were pioneered by {御木本|みきもと}{幸吉|こうきち} (Mikimoto Kokichi) in Japan.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧ - wild-caught, natural
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ - wild-caught (product)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {養殖|ようしょく}{業|ぎょう} - aquaculture industry
- {養殖|ようしょく}{場|じょう} - fish farm
- {養殖|ようしょく}{魚|ぎょ} - farmed fish
